content.value: An 8-ft-span cantilever beam has a rectangular section and reinforcement as (16) shown in figure. The beam carries a dead load, including its own weight, of 1.5 k/ft and a live load of 0.9 k/ft. Using $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 4 ~ \mathsf { k s i }$ and $f _ { y } = 6 0$ ksi, check if the beam is safe to carry the above loads.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
